description.short_caption: Swollen and erythematous finger with subungual discoloration.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a finger with marked swelling, erythema, and tenderness, particularly around the distal phalanx. The nail bed appears discolored, and there is a prominent area of redness extending from the nail fold. The findings suggest an infectious or inflammatory process, such as a paronychia or felon.
visible_findings: shiny, taut skin over the affected area

description.short_caption: Swollen, erythematous finger with tense skin and possible underlying infection.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a finger with marked swelling, erythema, and a tense, shiny appearance of the overlying skin. The nail is intact, and there is no visible ulceration or drainage. The findings suggest an acute inflammatory or infectious process, such as cellulitis or a felon. The surrounding tissue appears relatively spared, and the image is taken against a blue drape background.
